headline: HuyenBao v11.23 — nav tooltips + XP bar visibility + Power/Empire bullet explanations + Relations primary buttons
summary: UX clarity pass. (1) Tooltips for Level-2 nav icons — hover any subnav tab (Overview / Wellbeing / Education / Assets / Markets / Banking / Business / Space / Social / Relations / Clubs / Power / Empire / Ranking / Hall of Fame / Systems) to see a one-line description of what it contains. Implemented as a pure CSS tooltip (::after + attr(data-tip)) with fade-in + caret; no JS state, no extra dependencies. (2) XP progress bar visibility — the lvlchip bar in the header was 6px×74px (effectively invisible); now 9px×96px with a gradient fill + a thin next-level marker at the right edge. Added a hover tooltip on the lvlchip showing exact XP: 'Lv X · Y/Z XP (P%) · next in N XP'. (3) Power + Empire tier explanations converted from dense prose paragraph to scannable icon bullet list — each tier now shows 3 bullets (role / requirement-or-source / catch) with a small icon per bullet (check / xp / x for Power; check / xp / star for Empire). All 9 tier bullets added in EN/VI/ZH. (4) Relations tab — 'Trò chuyện' (Talk) and 'Tặng quà' (Gift) buttons changed from ghost (subtle) to default accent gold background, making them visually primary alongside 'Giúp' (Help) and 'Cãi' (Argue) which stay ghost. The propose/marry button keeps its sage-green special variant. Version bumped to v11.23 at FRONT of app name (v11.23 HuyenBao). 4 Huyen-Hoc-AI features unchanged.
